scene: The brass key activates a skyway terminal buzzing with departing vehicles.
picture: A flat side view of an expansive rooftop depot. On the far left, a red double-decker hover bus waits with doors open. In the left-centre, the grandmother in pink tracksuit holds her brass key and leash. In the centre, an ornate gondola drone floats beside the platform. On the far right, a shiny turquoise flying scooter rests on kickstands.
